memberdef.name: extractSidecarBinaries

briefdescription.para: Entry point for whatdbg — sidecar extraction and process bootstrap.

detaileddescription.para:
Startup sequence:
Extract platform debug engine from BinaryData to sidecar directory.
[macOS] Re-exec with DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH pointing to sidecar dir so dyld resolves liblldb SB API symbols on the second invocation.
Initialize logging (Debug builds only).
Initialize Whatdbg with the sidecar directory.
Run the DAP main loop.

Sidecar pattern is identical on both platforms:
Windows: dbgeng DLLs → ~/.config/whatdbg/dbgeng/ → LoadLibrary
macOS: liblldb.dylib → ~/Library/Application Support/whatdbg/liblldb/ → DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH + re-exec
